description: Source code for the X Recommendation Algorithm

summary.one_liner: Source code release of the services, models and jobs that X uses to build recommendation feeds for its For You Timeline and Recommended Notifications.
summary.what_it_does: The repository publishes parts of X's recommendation stack, covering the shared data services (tweetypie, unified-user-actions, user-signal-service), ML models (SimClusters, TwHIN, real-graph, tweepcred, trust-and-safety-models), and software frameworks (navi, product-mixer, timelines-aggregation-framework, twml). It includes the candidate sources, ranking models and post-mixing services used for the For You Timeline, such as search-index, tweet-mixer, UTEG, heavy-ranker, light-ranker and home-mixer. It also includes pushservice and its light and heavy rankers for Recommended Notifications. The README describes the architecture and component roles at a high level, and points to X's engineering blog for an introduction to how the algorithm works. Bazel BUILD files are included for most components. The README says the repo is for community issues and pull requests, with security issues routed to HackerOne.
use_cases: Studying how a large social feed recommender is architected
Reviewing candidate generation and ranking pipeline design
Exploring graph-based embeddings like SimClusters and TwHIN
Understanding how push notification recommendations are ranked
Reading source for a production model serving or feed-building framework
Looking up how For You timeline post sourcing and filtering fits together
how_to_run: Browse the component directories for the service or model of interest
Use the Bazel BUILD files in individual components to build them (no top-level BUILD or WORKSPACE file is provided)
notable: Covers the For You Timeline and Recommended Notifications surfaces in one codebase
Includes SimClusters community detection and TwHIN knowledge graph embeddings
Built on GraphJet for in-memory user-to-post interaction graph traversal
Uses product-mixer as the framework behind home-mixer
Includes navi, a Rust model serving system
caveats: No top-level build or test system; only some components have Bazel BUILD files
The README says a more complete build and test system is planned for the future
Shared components are described at a high level; the README gives no setup instructions for running the full system
